# libwebp

SuperMenu statically links libwebp 1.6.0 for WebP encoding.

Source archive: https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-1.6.0.tar.gz

SHA-256: e4ab7009bf0629fd11982d4c2aa83964cf244cffba7347ecd39019a9e38c4564

The archive includes COPYING, PATENTS and AUTHORS. The local build also copies COPYING and PATENTS into the app bundle. Run `scripts/prepare-webp.sh` to build the static libraries. A working C compiler and make from Apple Command Line Tools are required.
